text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text: Pheeew! We played our hearts out~~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Oh, let's buy some souvenirs too. I 
wanna look for a cute cookie tin~

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Once we get back, it's back to the 
same old daily routine. We gotta at least 
pump ourselves up with souvenirs~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
C'mooon, don't go bringing up bad 
memories~ I finally managed to forget 
about it, too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I don't wanna go back to reality~~.

Hishi Miracle grew gloomy under the 
setting sun...
